text:
**False as commonly stated—but “never visible” is also too absolute.**

NASA reports that the Great Wall is **generally not visible to the naked eye from low Earth orbit**, and certainly not from the Moon. Despite its length, it is only a few metres wide and blends into the surrounding terrain.

**Nuance:** Some astronauts report seeing sections under exceptionally favorable low-orbit conditions. Thus, altitude, lighting, and contrast matter; photographs taken with telephoto lenses do not establish naked-eye visibility.

Source: NASA, *“China’s Wall Less Great in View from Space.”*
